81: ## Regulations
82: 
83: - **BSP (Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas) Circular 982 / 1019 (IT Risk Management & Financial Access Controls)**: Mandates least-privilege access control across all financial data transformation, configuration, and governance endpoints (`0%` unmapped route access), immediate revocation upon role/permission deactivation or time-bounded role assignment expiry (`expires_at`), strict object-level ownership preventing unauthorized peer interference with batch runs or governance tickets, read-only enforcement during administrative support (`View-As`) sessions, and 13-month online retention of authorization denial audit logs (`AUTHZ_DENIED`, `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_BLOCKED`).
84: - **Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR**: Requires least-privilege RBAC and object-level authorization (BOLA) over workforce-initiated runs and governance tickets, and tamper-evident audit logging (`audit_log_entries`) recording actor identity, effective `View-As` role, target resource, denial reason, and correlation ID.
85: - **Internal GXI Enterprise Governance & Security Baseline (`security-baseline.mdc` §1, §2, §3, §11, §12 & VAPT F4, F8, F9, F10)**: Mandates `@PreAuthorize` on `100%` of controller endpoints, default-deny route permission evaluation (`FailClosedRoutePermissionGuard`), fail-closed `HTTP 503 SESSION_STORE_UNAVAILABLE` on session/authorization store outages, same-role peer negative BOLA verification on `{id}` endpoints (VAPT F8), `View-As` read-only mutation blocking (`VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`), and `Encode.forJava()` sanitization on all audit log entries.
